subject: "Distance sampling in R" paper reviewers requested

messages.subject: "Distance sampling in R" paper reviewers requested
parts:
Hi listfolk,

We (myself, Eric Rexstad, Len Thomas, Laura Marshall and Jeff Laake)
wrote a paper a while ago about doing distance sampling analyses in R
(which I think I posted a preprint of to this list some time ago). We
submitted this to the Journal of Statistical Software last year.
Unfortunately the journal has been unable to find willing reviewers
(after trying 15+ (!!)). The journal have come back to us to ask for
more suggestions.

We wonder if there are any potential reviewers on this list who would be
willing to review this paper for JSS?

A preprint can be found here:
http://biorxiv.org/content/early/2016/07/14/063891

Please contact me directly and I will forward your details onto the
journal or contact Edzer Pebesma (edzer....@uni-muenster.de) and
cite the author names and paper title.

Thank you in advance to any volunteers!

All the best,
--dave (on behalf of the Distance Development team)
